channel.title: The Hollywood Reporter - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Hollywood Reporter (hollywoodreporter.com)

item.title: “I Thought I Blew It”: Henry Thomas on the Audition, Trauma and Movie Magic Behind ‘E.T.’
item.description: Steven Spielberg's young discovery revisits the classic 43 years later on The Hollywood Reporter's 'It Happened in Hollywood' podcast.

item.title: Joey Fatone Is Producing an ID Doc Series About the Dark Side of Boy Bands
item.description: 'Boy Band Confidential' will feature revealing interviews with NSYNC's Lance Bass, Backstreet Boys' AJ McLean and Boyz II Men's Wanya Morris and Shawn Stockman.

item.title: The Freelance Platform Fiverr Wants to Sell You AI Video
item.description: The gig economy stalwart is partnering with a handful of established AI directors, like Billy Boman, to offer video production to small businesses at a “fraction of the cost.”

item.title: Hot Docs Fest to Open With ‘Antidiva: The Carole Pope Confessions’
item.description: The documentary fest also booked the SXSW Doc Spotlight winner ‘Ceremony’ and a world bow for Kim Nguyen’s ‘Saigon Story: Two Shootings in the Forest Kingdom.’

item.title: Live-Action ‘Mr Benn’ Film on the Way From ‘I Swear’ Writer-Director Kirk Jones
item.description: Based on David McKee's beloved book character and the subsequent animated series, 'Mr Benn' is set to cast its lead actor in the coming months.

item.title: Iran Air Strikes Hit House of Iranian Director Abbas Kiarostami (Report)
item.description: The son of the late Palme d'Or-winning filmmaker said his father's house was damaged in an air strike in the Chizar district of Tehran.

item.title: Wim Wenders to Receive Lifetime Achievement Award From German Film Academy
item.description: The honor is a sign of solidarity from the Academy with the 80-year-old director, who was sharply criticized for his filmmakers “should stay out of politics” comments he made at this year's Berlinale.

item.title: Kara Swisher Would Cut Ties With CNN If Ellisons Took Control
item.description: "They have no interest in journalism," the podcast host and network contributor says, adding, "I'm not working for you hacks."

item.title: Epic Games Slashes 1,000 Jobs, Citing “Downturn in ‘Fortnite’ Engagement”
item.description: The game studio is in business with Disney, which invested in it and is planning an interactive world filled with its IP.

item.title: Megan Thee Stallion Hospitalized in New York After Exiting ‘Moulin Rouge’ Performance Mid-Show
item.description: “During Tuesday night’s production, Megan started feeling very ill and was promptly transported to a local hospital, where her symptoms are currently being evaluated,” her rep tells The Hollywood Reporter.

item.title: Writers Guild West Staffers to Lose Health Coverage Soon Amid Strike
item.description: The co-chair of the Writers Guild Staff Union said that staffers learned on Tuesday that they will be ineligible for their health plan starting Wednesday.

item.title: Inside the Snappys: Snapchat Launches Inaugural Awards Show, With Kylie Jenner, David Dobrik Among Winners
item.description: Matt Friend hosted the celebration of creators from Snap's Santa Monica headquarters as he teased, "Why does it seem like everyone has an awards show now?"

item.title: Kathleen Kennedy Just Told an AI Conference She’s Not So Sure About AI
item.description: The longtime Spielberg producer and 'Star Wars' overseer says the absence of human experience on AI-driven projects gives her pause. She also said that when it comes to Big Tech "what's missing in the discussion right now is transparency."

item.title: Canal+ Names Anne‑Laure Tingry Chief Data & AI Officer
item.description: Reporting to CEO Maxime Saada, she will be responsible for data and AI strategy across all of the media company's markets and oversee "the implementation of projects in these areas."
